record.edic_text:
4868 sunairo {soon-ah'-ee-ro}

from 4862 and 142;; v

AV - take 1, reckon 1, reckon + 3056 1; 3

1) to take up together with another or others
2) to bring together with others
   2a) to cast up or settle accounts
   2b) to make a reckoning with
